description: Main window and onboarding: all data commands (projects' documents included), settings (with the recordings' folder, the data summary and «Удалить всё»: recordings_info, data_summary, data_delete_all), the microphones (audio_inputs_*), window controls, the storage retry, OS permissions, the agent CLI setup (with «Указать другой» and the limit: agent_check_path, agent_usage), the level meters, the microphone activity, the call in progress (call_*, discarded before «Удалить все данные» with call_discard; no window closes a finishing call: its summary build does, so call_close is no window's), reading the call's summary (summary_get), the recording's status (the call starts and stops it; recording_start and recording_stop are no window's), the call's questions, its findings (context_finding_hide) and the agent's calls, the speech models, the hardware check and the mic check, the project brief (build, cancel, prepare, export), the connectors (connectors_list, connect by key, disconnect, browse, the projects' selection and its sync; no window ever gets a secret), the open dialog (documents and the export folder) and the OS name (the Windows variant of onboarding), the app's updates (updates_get, updates_check, updates_install: «Обновления» in Settings and the toast of a downloaded update). A finished call's records are the main window's only: post-call.json.
